tools.name: extract_webpage
tools.description: Fetch any public web page and return clean readable Markdown (Readability), title, description, og:image, byline, word count and outgoing links. Ideal for LLM agents that need page content without HTML noise. Costs $0.003 USDC (x402, Base).

tools.name: detect_tech_stack
tools.description: Detect the technology stack of a website: frameworks (Next.js, React, Vue, Angular...), CMS (WordPress, Shopify, Webflow...), analytics, payments, CDN/hosting and server headers. Useful for lead qualification and competitor research. Costs $0.003 USDC (x402, Base).

tools.name: check_email_domain
tools.description: Check an email address or domain: MX records, mail provider (Google/Microsoft/Zoho), SPF, DMARC policy, disposable-domain flag and a 0-100 deliverability score. Validate leads before sending. Costs $0.002 USDC (x402, Base).

tools.name: pricing
tools.description: Free. Lists tools, prices and payment details of this server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: extract_webpage, check_email_domain · Private data: check_email_domain · Public sink: check_email_domain.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: extract_webpage, check_email_domain · Private data: check_email_domain · Public sink: check_email_domain

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
